purpose: Primary-source references for per-page URL previews. This records requirements separately from project design choices; it does not claim search or social platforms will display a particular preview.

projectChoice.reason: A consistent high-resolution landscape export for the site's original share artwork. These exact dimensions are a project choice, not a requirement of the Open Graph protocol.
projectChoice.consistency: Use the same absolute HTTPS image URL, descriptive alt text and actual pixel dimensions across Open Graph, X card metadata and the page's ImageObject. Keep canonical and existing indexing directives unchanged.
projectChoice.limitation: Text-led share cards favor readable social previews. Google recommends avoiding text in a preferred search image, so title cards must not be described as fully satisfying that recommendation. A representative illustration without text is preferable when available.

sources.title: The Open Graph protocol
notes: Core properties are og:title, og:type, og:image and og:url.
Image structured properties include HTTPS secure_url, MIME type, pixel width and height, and alt describing the image.
Place structured properties after their og:image root; another image root starts a new image group.
The protocol does not prescribe one image size or image file format.

sources.title: Google image SEO best practices
notes: Google can use og:image or WebPage.primaryImageOfPage as a preferred-image signal; primaryImageOfPage may be a URL or ImageObject.
Images should represent the page, use high resolution and avoid extreme aspect ratios, generic logos and text. Selection remains automated.
Google Images supports BMP, GIF, JPEG, PNG, WebP, SVG and AVIF. Broader Google support does not establish social-platform SVG support.
Use descriptive alt text without keyword stuffing. HTML img/src and an image sitemap can help image discovery.

sources.title: Schema.org primaryImageOfPage and ImageObject
notes: primaryImageOfPage applies to WebPage and expects ImageObject in the Schema.org vocabulary.
ImageObject supports contentUrl, encodingFormat, width, height, description and representativeOfPage. Use the actual image bytes URL and truthful dimensions.
WebPage.image can reference the same ImageObject. Do not manufacture article type, licensing, creator or publication facts.

sources.title: X legacy Cards documentation availability
sources.status: Legacy card URLs redirected to https://docs.x.com/overview; the current top-level documentation index did not expose a Cards section. The attempted new cards path was unavailable.
notes: Current official card-specific format, pixel, aspect-ratio, byte-size and alt-length limits could not be verified from live X documentation in this check.
Keep the existing explicit Twitter card tags and provide PNG exports and descriptive alt text. Do not cite third-party reproductions as current official X requirements.

verificationBoundary: Local tests can verify generated PNG bytes, dimensions, metadata agreement and protected-file hashes. Actual platform fetches, caching and rendered preview selection require a reachable published URL and remain unverified by this local-only change.
